crossRefs.note: My heart was hot within me. While I meditated, the fire burned. I spoke with my tongue:
If I say, I will not make mention of him, or speak any more in his name, then there is in my heart as it were a burning…
So the Spirit lifted me up, and took me away; and I went in bitterness, in the heat of my spirit; and Yahweh’s hand was…
for we can’t help telling the things which we saw and heard.”
For if we are beside ourselves, it is for God. Or if we are of sober mind, it is for you.
For the love of Christ constrains us; because we judge thus, that one died for all, therefore all died.

translations.web: For I am full of words. The spirit within me constrains me.
translations.bsb: For I am full of words, and my spirit within me compels me.
translations.kjv: For I am full of matter, the spirit within me constraineth
translations.asv: For I am full of words; The spirit within me constraineth me.
